insights.title: High Latency on SIMS Finance Home
insights.description: The POST /sfdemosite130/simsfinance.home endpoint shows a p95 latency of 5693ms, indicating a significant delay in accessing the main application interface.
insights.recommendation: Investigate the backend processing for the SIMS Finance home page to identify and resolve latency issues.

insights.title: Excessive Calls to Refresh Control
insights.description: The endpoint POST /sfdemosite130/nml510_refresh_control.xml was called 26 times in a single test, suggesting potential inefficiencies.
insights.recommendation: Review the logic for refreshing controls to minimize unnecessary repeated calls.

insights.title: UI Actions Trigger API Calls
insights.description: User actions such as logging in and accessing reports directly correlate with specific API calls, indicating a clear UI-API relationship.
insights.recommendation: Document the UI-API interactions to enhance understanding of user workflows.

executiveSummary:
• The tests captured a total of 185 API calls across various workflows.
• High latency was observed on the SIMS Finance home page, with a p95 of 5693ms.
• Excessive calls to the refresh control endpoint may indicate inefficiencies in the process.
• User actions are closely linked to specific API calls, demonstrating a clear UI-API relationship.
• These patterns suggest areas for performance improvement and optimization in user workflows.
